title: Saddle Networks: Structure-Preserving Architectures for Convex-Concave Functions
summary: Saddle-point models arise throughout optimization, optimal transport, robust learning, and control. In many applications, the relevant function f(x,y) is convex in x and concave in y, and preserving this geometry is essential for obtaining tractable min--max formulations and reliable certificates. We introduce a structured separable decomposition that preserves the convex-concave geometry and prove a complete one-dimensional approximation theorem under a mixed Monge-type convexity condition.
